                                       access to the computer/domain.

*Users                                 Users are prevented from 
                                       unauthorized access to the 
                                       computer/domain.

*Guests                                Guests are allowed limited access 
                                       to the computer/domain.

*Remote Desktop Users                  Users who are allowed to connect 
                                       remotely.

*Power Users                           Power Users have more access than 
                                       regular Users but less than 
                                       Administrators.

*Backup Operators                       Backup operators can bypass file 
                                       security to back up files.

*Replicator                             Allows a user to replicate file 
                                       changes in the domain.

*Authenticated Users                   Users who have permission to 
                                       authenticate.
